status: experiment lock source: spatial SELECTED+LINKED recorded-count research experiments (temporal OOF selection, previously-seen 2024/25 diagnostics, fixed spatial-transfer diagnostic); NO serving, colours, API or production claim

label_meaning: y = count of SELECTED+LINKED retained MOT database records (status_50m == matched AND segment_status == assigned) per qualified DOH segment x local day (daily) or x 6 h block. Zero means zero such recorded+linked records, NOT zero physical accidents. Predictions are expected recorded counts, not per-vehicle or per-person probabilities.

sampling.use: model training ONLY (never baselines, evaluation metrics, prevalence, calibration or colour cutoffs)

definitions.notation: b = time block (daily: the single block); T_b = number of training target dates whose block b ends <= training cutoff (exact full calendar, every universe segment counted, NOT sampled rows); C = training record counts from the sparse index; L_s = segment projected length km; S_train = training segment set
definitions.global_length_rate: rate_g_b = C_b / (sum_{s in S_train} L_s * T_b) records per km per cell; prediction rate_g_b * L_s
definitions.route_length_rate: rate_r_b = C_rb / (sum_{s in S_train, route r} L_s * T_b) (may be 0 when the route has no training records: no pseudocounts); prediction rate_r_b * L_s; route absent from S_train -> global_length_rate
definitions.parent: P_sb = route_length_rate prediction for s (global_length_rate when the route is unseen)
definitions.segment_mean_k: (C_sb + k * P_sb) / (N_sb + k), N_sb = T_b for training segments, 0 for unseen segments (-> exactly P_sb)
definitions.segment_weekday_k10: (C_s,wd,b + 10 * M30_sb) / (N_wd,b + 10), N_wd,b = number of training dates with that weekday for block b (0 for unseen segments), M30 = segment_mean_k30
definitions.segment_month_k30: (C_s,m,b + 30 * M30_sb) / (N_m,b + 30), N_m,b = training dates in calendar month m for block b
definitions.recent90_segment: C_sb(last 90 calendar days ending at the last eligible training date of block b, clipped at train_start) / N_recent_b; segment_mean_k30 when N_recent_b == 0 or the segment is unseen
definitions.floor: no floor is applied to predictions; zero predictions are allowed (route/global rate 0) and are floored at 1e-12 ONLY inside the Poisson deviance metric; negative means are refused

preprocessing.poisson: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') on categoricals; numeric SimpleImputer(median, keep_empty_features=True) + StandardScaler; all fitted on the fold training sample only
preprocessing.random_forest: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') on categoricals; numeric SimpleImputer(median, keep_empty_features=True); training sample only
preprocessing.hist_gradient_boosting: OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown='use_encoded_value', unknown_value=NaN, encoded_missing_value=NaN) on categoricals with categorical mask; numeric NaN native

policies.routed_context: context fit iff ALL of weather daily (+ weather block for 6h) and the 3 AADT features are finite, else the SAME config calendar_geometry fit (deployment eligible; requires both component fits in every fold)
policies.context: pure calendar_geometry_context fit (ablation only, never eligible)

candidates.tie_break: lower pooled OOF mean Poisson deviance; exact ties prefer core over routed_context, then config order above
candidates.infrequent_category_policy: national V4: max_category_cardinality is the encoder max_categories; the most frequent levels in the fold training sample keep their own level, the rest share one infrequent level (OneHotEncoder infrequent_if_exist / OrdinalEncoder max_categories). v3 refused fits above the cap; the pilot never exceeded it (218 routes).
candidates.sparse_one_hot_note: national V4: Poisson/RF one-hot output is sparse (CSR) instead of dense; same features and estimators. Measured on the daily 2023H2 sample: identical RF prediction mean, Poisson |diff| ~1e-11, RF memory 4.85 -> 1.71 GB. The dense 6 h sample (3.47M rows x ~300 columns) did not fit in 16 GB RAM.
candidates.national_scope_note: national V4 (2026-11-20, user decision for compute time): only hgb_poisson_fixed is fitted. It was the selected candidate in the accepted pilot (daily and 6 h). Poisson and RandomForest are not re-compared nationally; the HGB policy must still beat the strongest nonzero baseline under the unchanged selection gates, otherwise the baseline is used.

selection.rule: per unit: best deployment-eligible candidate policy by pooled OOF deviance vs strongest NONZERO baseline by pooled OOF deviance; recommend candidate only if relative reduction >= 1% AND MAE ratio <= 1.02 AND strictly lower deviance in >= 3/4 folds, otherwise the baseline. Frozen before any 2024/25 metric is computed.

bootstrap.policy: paired exploratory moving-free calendar block bootstrap over the 2022-23 OOF dates: consecutive non-overlapping 7-day blocks from 2022-01-01, the final partial block kept as its own block; all segments/blocks of a day move together; statistic = 1 - sum dev(candidate) / sum dev(baseline); post-selection, not confirmatory, no multiplicity adjustment

transfer.note: geometry-only contiguous unseen-SECTION diagnostic; not all-new routes, not untouched future; never reranks the temporal winner

resources.fit_cache_note: content-addressed cache of successful fits (backend/rerun-fitcache-<version>, gitignored) so an interrupted run resumes; hits are reported in the manifest
